annotations.text:
Create — the chosen direction.

Inputs on the left, the running job large on the right with live preview, variation strip and per-result actions. Advanced drawer shown open so the full control set is visible; it collapses by default and remembers your choice.

The Image/Video toggle sits in the left panel header — switching it swaps the input panel, not the whole app.

Animate — the second route into video, opened from any image. Source frame and camera presets left, motion prompt and video model right.

The strip underneath is the long-running job: frame count, ETA, and an explicit 'you can close this tab' — the job lives on the server, not in the page.
Library — grouped by day, filtered by images / video / starred / model. Selecting an asset opens the detail drawer with the full generation record, a copyable seed, and Download / Remix / Animate.
Models — Discover. Civitai / Hugging Face toggle, type and base-model filters, install state on every card. One card is mid-download, using the same progress plumbing as a generation job.
